You fire a length of wire at a foe within 30 feet, making a ranged tech attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 2d10 kinetic damage, and you can pull it up to 25 feet toward you. A critical hit also knocks the target prone. If the target ends this movement within 5 feet of you and is no more than one size larger than you, it becomes grappled by you for the duration.

A creature you grapple this way must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your tech save DC to escape using its action. The power ends if the attack misses or the grapple ends.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the kinetic damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level beyond 2nd.
